protocol: Three seeds. Each selective arm evaluates the same number of proposals on development data only. Untouched, random, scaling, direction, direct, program and hybrid arms are included. Direct and program apply one head-scale grid. No final-set failures are used to choose edits.

bin_majority.interpretation: Held-out accuracy and NLL must both improve on every seed before a method is listed. A single-seed or NLL-only change is not superiority.

unique_copy.interpretation: Held-out accuracy and NLL must both improve on every seed before a method is listed. A single-seed or NLL-only change is not superiority.

sort.interpretation: Held-out accuracy and NLL must both improve on every seed before a method is listed. A single-seed or NLL-only change is not superiority.

language_model.restoration: undo package restored the checkpoint that existed before the saved edit

passage.author: Jane Austen
passage.note: Opening of Chapter I is the target passage. Opening of Chapter II is the collateral passage. Illustration captions and 1894 copyright lines were removed. This is not a benchmark leaderboard.

language_model.interpretation: Next-token windows from a public-domain novel. The same windows are repeated across seeds; only the random arm draws new proposals. Collateral is a later chapter and is not used for selection. This is not a language-benchmark win and is separate from symbolic rule rewriting.

grok_agent.reason: baseline arms do not call an external agent
